<tbody><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_row54611651575"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p5113491982"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p5113491982"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p5113491982"></a>&lt;primary_card_bandwidth&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p171131095816"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p171131095816"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p171131095816"></a>整型值，主卡服务小区带宽，单位：MHz。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1356717913819"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1356717913819"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1356717913819"></a>未注册成功时查询为0。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_row164611151878"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1311113916813"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1311113916813"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1311113916813"></a>&lt;primary_card_duplex_mode&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1510773531312"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1510773531312"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1510773531312"></a>整型值，主卡服务小区制式。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1949917576238"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1949917576238"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1949917576238"></a>0：fdd；</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p17789150192418"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p17789150192418"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p17789150192418"></a>1：tdd。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_row429781619498"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p310914912814"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p310914912814"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p310914912814"></a>&lt;primary_ul_thp_level&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p109511484103"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p109511484103"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p109511484103"></a>整型值，主卡服务小区预估速率档位。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p29631448153118"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p29631448153118"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p29631448153118"></a>有效值为1～5，档位越高预估速率越高。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p496334817312"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p496334817312"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p496334817312"></a>无效值为0，此时小区制式也无效。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_row16723171710815"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p12724917386"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p12724917386"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p12724917386"></a>&lt;secondary_card_bandwidth&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1272417177810"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1272417177810"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1272417177810"></a>整型值，副卡历史驻留小区带宽，单位：MHz。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1388582714819"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1388582714819"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1388582714819"></a>副卡之前未注册成功查询为0。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_row563526124914"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p181081191282"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p181081191282"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p181081191282"></a>&lt;secondary_card_duplex_mode&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p5118124913131"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p5118124913131"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p5118124913131"></a>整型值，副卡历史驻留小区制式。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1693112514276"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1693112514276"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1693112514276"></a>0：fdd；</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p9931135102713"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p9931135102713"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p9931135102713"></a>1：tdd。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_row663619634916"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1510620915813"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1510620915813"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1510620915813"></a>&lt; secondary_ul_thp_leve&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p01051794815"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p01051794815"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p01051794815"></a>整型值，副卡历史驻留小区预估速率档位。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p17591151118543"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p17591151118543"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p17591151118543"></a>有效值为1～5，档位越高预估速率越高。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p2591151116543"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p2591151116543"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p2591151116543"></a>无效值为0，此时小区制式也无效。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_row1599525318444"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1499611533449"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1499611533449"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p1499611533449"></a>&lt;buffer_ratio&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p899645374417"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p899645374417"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p899645374417"></a>整型值，主卡服务小区上行缓存比例（上行使用缓存/上行丢包门限×100）。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p199771142165012"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p199771142165012"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_p199771142165012"></a>有效值1~100。</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**实现说明<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354702617_section5446mcpsimp"></a>**

主卡是根据当前小区参数实时计算的预估值，副卡是本次硬上电之后上次使用副卡驻留的预估值。

### 迟滞定时器超时主动上报切卡建议：+NIPCSUGGEST<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002501260712"></a>

**命令描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_section4340133117813"></a>**

迟滞定时器超时时，根据主副卡速率对比结果上报切卡建议；如果速率对比适合切卡，则上报建议切卡，否则上报不建议切卡。

>![](public_sys-resources/icon-note.gif) **说明：** 
>需同时打开宏SUPPORT\_IPC\_AUTO\_SWITCH\_CARD 和 SUPPORT\_SIM1\_HOT\_PLUG。

**命令语法<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_section27467181898"></a>**

<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_table143981800489"></a>
<table><thead align="left"><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_row139817074814"><th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="25.882588258825876%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.1"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p173981104481"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p173981104481"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p173981104481"></a>命令</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="37.37373737373737%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.2"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p339915016481"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p339915016481"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p339915016481"></a>返回结果</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="36.743674367436746%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.3"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p4399902485"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p4399902485"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p4399902485"></a>示例</p>
</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_row23995014487"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="25.882588258825876%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p153046464011"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p153046464011"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p153046464011"></a>-</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="37.37373737373737%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p13041463010"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p13041463010"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p13041463010"></a>+NIPCSUGGEST: &lt;is_switch&gt;,[&lt;usim_id&gt;],[&lt;error_reason&gt;]</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="36.743674367436746%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.3 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p43147337277"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p43147337277"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p43147337277"></a>+NIPCSUGGEST: 1,1,</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p6314133302712"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p6314133302712"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p6314133302712"></a>+NIPCSUGGEST: 0,,1</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**参数描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_section45087272918"></a>**

<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_table198852334716"></a>
<table><thead align="left"><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_row1881723154712"><th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" id="mcps1.1.3.1.1"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p78862364716"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p78862364716"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p78862364716"></a>参数</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" id="mcps1.1.3.1.2"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p4888231472"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p4888231472"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p4888231472"></a>描述</p>
</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_row1716315410495"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p1915524820015"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p1915524820015"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p1915524820015"></a>&lt;is_switch &gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p15250458172712"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p15250458172712"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p15250458172712"></a>整型值，建议是否切卡。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p10250185872712"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p10250185872712"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p10250185872712"></a>0：建议不切卡；</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p6250358172710"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p6250358172710"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p6250358172710"></a>1：建议切卡。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_row1247152414441"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p5152134812013"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p5152134812013"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p5152134812013"></a>&lt;usim_id &gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p1115112482019"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p1115112482019"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p1115112482019"></a>整型值，当&lt;is_switch &gt;为1时有效，为另一个卡槽的id。&lt;is_switch &gt;为0时为空。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p18895943105610"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p18895943105610"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p18895943105610"></a>0：卡槽0；</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p889594320568"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p889594320568"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p889594320568"></a>1：卡槽1。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_row10722124692717"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.29%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p77221046142719"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p77221046142719"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p77221046142719"></a>&lt;error_reason&gt;（原因值可添加）</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p1920119581281"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p1920119581281"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p1920119581281"></a>整型值，当&lt;is_switch &gt;为0时有效，当&lt;is_switch &gt;为1时为空。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p420115816285"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p420115816285"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002354742785_p420115816285"></a>1：当前主卡速率平稳，不建议切卡。</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### 控制迟滞定时器开关时长及预估速率折算系数配置：+NIPCLEN<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002533183109"></a>

**命令描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_section4340133117813"></a>**

控制（启动、重启或关闭）迟滞定时器，并可设置迟滞定时器时长及预估速率折算比例系数。

>![](public_sys-resources/icon-note.gif) **说明：** 
>需同时打开宏SUPPORT\_IPC\_AUTO\_SWITCH\_CARD 和 SUPPORT\_SIM1\_HOT\_PLUG。

**命令语法<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_section27467181898"></a>**

<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_table143981800489"></a>
<table><thead align="left"><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_row139817074814"><th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.312931293129314%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.1"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p173981104481"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p173981104481"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p173981104481"></a>命令</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="33.943394339433944%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.2"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p339915016481"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p339915016481"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p339915016481"></a>返回结果</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="36.743674367436746%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.3"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p4399902485"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p4399902485"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p4399902485"></a>示例</p>
</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_row23995014487"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.312931293129314%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p2192195010017"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p2192195010017"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p2192195010017"></a>+NIPCLEN=&lt;time_len&gt;[,&lt;net_convert&gt;]</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="33.943394339433944%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p1699475083019"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p1699475083019"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p1699475083019"></a>OK</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p129941850133011"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p129941850133011"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p129941850133011"></a>错误情况：</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p2994350163012"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p2994350163012"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p2994350163012"></a>+CME ERROR: &lt;err&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="36.743674367436746%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.3 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p1519095015013"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p1519095015013"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p1519095015013"></a>AT+NIPCLEN=5,9</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p16521733317"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p16521733317"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p16521733317"></a>OK</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_row1168915851411"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.312931293129314%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p141891504010"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p141891504010"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p141891504010"></a>+NIPCLEN?</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="33.943394339433944%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p81882501805"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p81882501805"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p81882501805"></a>+NIPCLEN: &lt;time_len&gt;,&lt;net_convert&gt;</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p191392114320"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p191392114320"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p191392114320"></a>错误情况：</p>

</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="73.24000000000001%" id="mcps1.1.3.1.2"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p4888231472"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p4888231472"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p4888231472"></a>描述</p>
</th>
</tr>
</thead>

</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="73.24000000000001%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p20235591403"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p20235591403"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p20235591403"></a>整型值，迟滞定时器时长及周期检测开关，默认：60，取值范围：0～1440，单位：min。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p7235298409"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p7235298409"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p7235298409"></a>0：表示关闭定时器。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p3235189134013"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p3235189134013"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p3235189134013"></a>≥1：表示启动定时器，数字大小表示定时器时长。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_row1385311362488"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="26.76%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p2085313619486"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p2085313619486"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p2085313619486"></a>&lt;net_convert&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="73.24000000000001%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p10433193074016"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p10433193074016"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p10433193074016"></a>整型值，预估速率折算配比系数，默认值：10，取值范围：1～10。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p6853183615488"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p6853183615488"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_p6853183615488"></a>n表示折算比为n×10%。</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**实现说明<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002320744042_section5446mcpsimp"></a>**

-   当定时器时长设置为0时，则停止迟滞定时器，并且不再启动迟滞定时器。
-   当定时器时长不为0时，设置定时器时长，并重启定时器。
-   AT+NIPCLEN，是用配置的时长启动/重启定时器。
-   折算配比系数，按照折算比例为0.1×n对当前计算的小区预估速率进折算，默认为10，即不进行折算。
-   配置不写NV。

### 控制IPC智能选卡中最长搜网时长配置：+NIPCREGTIME<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002509724425"></a>

**命令描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002367589628_section4340133117813"></a>**

设置IPC选卡过程中发起注册后到等待注册结果的定时器时长。

>![](public_sys-resources/icon-note.gif) **说明：** 
>需同时打开宏SUPPORT\_IPC\_AUTO\_SWITCH\_CARD和SUPPORT\_SIM1\_HOT\_PLUG。

**实现说明<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002367589628_section45087272918"></a>**

配置不写NV。

### SPI网卡拨号：+SPINIC<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002477644970"></a>

>![](public_sys-resources/icon-note.gif) **说明：** 
>SPI网卡拨号需打开宏SUPPORT\_SPI\_NIC，SPI网卡拨号与PPP E5拨号和RNDIS E5拨号互斥。

**命令描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_section4340133117813"></a>**

SPI网卡承载上下文激活/去激活。

该命令支持<cid\>0\~10对应的PDP上下文激活，支持SPINIC激活的PDP上下文去激活，支持SPINIC激活的PDP上下文查询状态。

<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_table198852334716"></a>
<table><thead align="left"><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_row1881723154712"><th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="19.71%" id="mcps1.1.3.1.1"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p78862364716"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p78862364716"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p78862364716"></a>参数</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="80.28999999999999%" id="mcps1.1.3.1.2"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p4888231472"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p4888231472"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p4888231472"></a>描述</p>
</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_row163419293469"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="19.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p113522920466"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p113522920466"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p113522920466"></a>&lt;state&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="80.28999999999999%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p7913540124613"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p7913540124613"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p7913540124613"></a>整数类型；表示PDP上下文激活的状态。默认值为制造商特定。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p2913140124611"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p2913140124611"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p2913140124611"></a>0：去激活；</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p1392885618468"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p1392885618468"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p1392885618468"></a>1：激活。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_row488023104710"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="19.71%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p1994110212518"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p1994110212518"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p1994110212518"></a>&lt;cid&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="80.28999999999999%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p15601924111314"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p15601924111314"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_p15601924111314"></a>整数类型；PDP上下文标识符，set命令只支持激活激活&lt;cid&gt;0～10对应的承载，支持去激活&lt;cid&gt;0～17对应的承载，查询命令可查询到&lt;cid&gt;0~17的状态。</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**实现说明<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373825284_section194131177010"></a>**

最多支持激活8路承载（参见3GPP TS 36.331 R14 subclause 11.1 UE capability related constraints中DRB数量的定义）

### 设置速率模式：+NRATEMODE<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002477644500"></a>

**命令描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_section4340133117813"></a>**

>![](public_sys-resources/icon-note.gif) **说明：** 
>设置速率模式时，当effective\_type等于0或缺省时需重新启动芯片生效。

</td>

**参数描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_section45087272918"></a>**

<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_table198852334716"></a>
<table><thead align="left"><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_row1881723154712"><th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.26%" id="mcps1.1.3.1.1"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p78862364716"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p78862364716"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p78862364716"></a>参数</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.74000000000001%" id="mcps1.1.3.1.2"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p4888231472"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p4888231472"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p4888231472"></a>描述</p>
</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_row1716315410495"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.26%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p15163848497"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p15163848497"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p15163848497"></a>&lt;mode&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.74000000000001%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p107169822514"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p107169822514"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p107169822514"></a>取值范围：0～1。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p1742181418367"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p1742181418367"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p1742181418367"></a>0：高速模式；</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p142893581327"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p142893581327"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p142893581327"></a>1：低速模式。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p76852024193613"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p76852024193613"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p76852024193613"></a>低速模式下当业务速率超规格时，可能会出现由于申请内存失败而导致的系统自愈复位，请严格按照规格使用。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_row916871422115"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="29.26%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p61681514132113"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p61681514132113"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p61681514132113"></a>&lt;effective_type&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="70.74000000000001%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p2168141412213"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p2168141412213"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p2168141412213"></a>配置生效类型：0~1。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p489312519255"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p489312519255"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p489312519255"></a>0：该参数为0时，配置写入到NV中，需要重启芯片生效；</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p1880011106265"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p1880011106265"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p1880011106265"></a>1：该参数为1时，配置不写入NV，该命令只能在CFUN=0时执行，否则返回错误；芯片重启后使用NV中的mode配置值生效。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p6205115310267"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p6205115310267"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002373688132_p6205115310267"></a>该参数缺省时，配置默认写入NV。</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

### 设置上行内存流控门限：+NFCMEMBYTE<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002501420574"></a>

**命令描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_section4340133117813"></a>**

设置上行内存流控门限，触发流控后会丢弃上行数据包。

**命令语法<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_section27467181898"></a>**

<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_table143981800489"></a>
<table><thead align="left"><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_row139817074814"><th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="28.83288328832883%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.1"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_p173981104481"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_p173981104481"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_p173981104481"></a>命令</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="34.423442344234424%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.2"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_p339915016481"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_p339915016481"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_p339915016481"></a>返回结果</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="36.743674367436746%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.3"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_p4399902485"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_p4399902485"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002436789672_p4399902485"></a>示例</p>
</th>

### 上行预估速率上报：+NRATEADAPT<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002549029071"></a>

## 读取芯片类型：+NCHIPTYPE<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002223672556"></a>

**命令描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002063130129_section4340133117813"></a>**

该命令用来读取芯片的类型。它定义了产品形态。此efuse用于指示标记ID，并被SW用于定义不同的产品形态。

对于可能的<err\>取值，请参见“[错误码](#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002223512752)”章节。

## NV备份：&W<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002258632241"></a>

**命令描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002027170238_section4340133117813"></a>**

设置命令用来将当前所有NV配置保存到备份区。

该命令用于备份密钥，以防密钥意外损坏。

该命令不应反复使用，例如，使用后很快再次使用。

最大备份次数为255次，全擦除模式下修改版本后，备份次数会被重置。

## NV恢复：&F<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002223512740"></a>

**实现说明<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002027170294_section163753741216"></a>**

-   不能与AT命令结合使用。
-   只能在MT关机时设置，确保在发送AT+CFUN=0后设置。

>![](public_sys-resources/icon-note.gif) **说明：** 
>NRDTEST命令中的data参数均为十六进制的小端序存储格式，需要将其转换为大端序后，再将其转换为10进制则为实际参数值。

-   **[LL1\_ACTIVATE\_REQ](#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002337177716)**  

-   **[LL1\_DEACTIVATE\_REQ](#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002371295801)**  

-   **[LL1\_RADIO\_TEST\_MODE\_ENABLE](#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002371255657)**  

-   **[LL1\_RADIO\_TEST\_MODE\_DISABLE](#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002337337456)**

## 射频配置控制命令：+NRDCTRL<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002258632249"></a>

**命令描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_section4340133117813"></a>**

该命令用于进入无线测试模式。

**命令语法<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_section27467181898"></a>**

<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_table143981800489"></a>
<table><thead align="left"><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_row139817074814"><th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="33.33333333333333%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.1"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p173981104481"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p173981104481"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p173981104481"></a>命令</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="33.3033303330333%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.2"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p339915016481"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p339915016481"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p339915016481"></a>返回结果</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="33.36333633363336%" id="mcps1.1.4.1.3"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p4399902485"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p4399902485"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p4399902485"></a>示例</p>
</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_row23995014487"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="33.33333333333333%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1384141119289"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1384141119289"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1384141119289"></a>+NRDCTRL=&lt;state&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="33.3033303330333%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p2623mcpsimp"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p2623mcpsimp"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p2623mcpsimp"></a>&lt;result&gt;</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p14157203754713"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p14157203754713"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p14157203754713"></a>错误情况:</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p2625mcpsimp"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p2625mcpsimp"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p2625mcpsimp"></a>+CME ERROR: &lt;err&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="33.36333633363336%" headers="mcps1.1.4.1.3 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p113662030172811"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p113662030172811"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p113662030172811"></a>AT+NRDCTRL=1</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1336611305281"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1336611305281"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1336611305281"></a>OK</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p83668301284"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p83668301284"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p83668301284"></a>enter radio test</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**参数描述<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_section45087272918"></a>**

<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_table198852334716"></a>
<table><thead align="left"><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_row1881723154712"><th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="27.48%" id="mcps1.1.3.1.1"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p78862364716"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p78862364716"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p78862364716"></a>参数</p>
</th>
<th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="72.52%" id="mcps1.1.3.1.2"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p4888231472"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p4888231472"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p4888231472"></a>描述</p>
</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_row488023104710"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="27.48%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p19438516111714"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p19438516111714"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p19438516111714"></a>&lt;state&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="72.52%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1117171114420"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1117171114420"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1117171114420"></a>整数类型，选择radio test的状态。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p122889200309"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p122889200309"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p122889200309"></a>0：关闭；</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1112561710429"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1112561710429"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p1112561710429"></a>1：激活。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_row023517191242"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="27.48%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p4438161617178"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p4438161617178"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p4438161617178"></a>&lt;result&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="72.52%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p197879543214"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p197879543214"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p197879543214"></a>字符串，无线测试状态返回。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p137879520329"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p137879520329"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p137879520329"></a>进入测试：“enter radio test”</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p11787557325"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p11787557325"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_p11787557325"></a>退出测试：“quit radio test”</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**实现说明<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002224312317_section21806916286"></a>**

-   如果在”OK”后打印信息“enter radio test”，则表示进入无线测试成功，否则进入失败。
-   只能在关机时设置，确保在发送AT+CFUN=0后设置。

**实现说明<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_section155283712448"></a>**

-   命令返回OK后返回0和done说明控制成功，仅有OK控制失败。
-   发送单音或调制信号前，都需要先发送TX START打开TX通道；测量RSSI前也需要先发送RX START。

    发送单音示例如下：

    AT+NRDCTRL=1

    AT+NRDSET=TX START,8,897500,3,23,0

    AT+NRDSET=TX TONE,1,1500000,770

    发送调制信号示例如下：

    AT+NRDCTRL=1

    AT+NRDSET=TX START,8,897500,3,23,0

    AT+NRDSET=TX HW SEND START,6,12,0,1192,0

    开启RX测RSSI示例如下：

    AT+NRDCTRL=1

    AT+NRDSET=RX START,8,942500,0,7,0

    AT+NRDEXEC=RX DC CALI\(校准DC\)

    AT+NRDSET=WBRSSI READ,7,100

    发送单音或调制信号后，可调APC功率，以单音为例：

    AT+NRDCTRL=1

    AT+NRDSET=TX START,8,897500,3,23,0

    AT+NRDSET=TX TONE,1,1500000,770

    AT+NRDSET=TX APC,0,19,0

-   mcs推荐配置如下表：

    <a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_table19577142185012"></a>
    <table><thead align="left"><tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_row4577122175015"><th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="14.285714285714285%" id="mcps1.1.8.1.1"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p1057732185010"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p1057732185010"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p1057732185010"></a>配置</p>
    </th>
    <th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="14.285714285714285%" id="mcps1.1.8.1.2"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p18577021195019"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p18577021195019"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p18577021195019"></a>1.4M</p>
    </th>
    <th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="14.285714285714285%" id="mcps1.1.8.1.3"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p13577182185019"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p13577182185019"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p13577182185019"></a>3M</p>
    </th>
    <th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="14.285714285714285%" id="mcps1.1.8.1.4"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p115773216507"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p115773216507"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p115773216507"></a>5M</p>
    </th>
    <th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="14.285714285714285%" id="mcps1.1.8.1.5"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p55775218506"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p55775218506"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p55775218506"></a>10M</p>
    </th>
    <th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="14.285714285714285%" id="mcps1.1.8.1.6"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p557872113503"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p557872113503"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p557872113503"></a>15M</p>
    </th>
    <th class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="14.285714285714285%" id="mcps1.1.8.1.7"><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p957812217505"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p957812217505"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002189382778_p957812217505"></a>20M</p>
    </th>

## 射频配置执行命令：+NRDEXEC<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002258472361"></a>

<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="72.52%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p56365515175"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p56365515175"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p56365515175"></a>整数类型。</p>

<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p2639mcpsimp"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p2639mcpsimp"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p2639mcpsimp"></a>1：写入radioconfig数据。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p827732817571"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p827732817571"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p827732817571"></a>2：重新加载radioconfig。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_row023517191242"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="27.48%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p4438161617178"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p4438161617178"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p4438161617178"></a>&lt;len&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="72.52%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p18283101711208"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p18283101711208"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p18283101711208"></a>表示数据长度，单位：Byte。最大长度1024。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_row11552152115413"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="27.48%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p34378162173"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p34378162173"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p34378162173"></a>&lt;data&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="72.52%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p483015111710"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p483015111710"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p483015111710"></a>传输的数据，格式为十六进制字符串。</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_row1720419151916"><td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="27.48%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.1 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p1220414159916"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p1220414159916"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p1220414159916"></a>&lt;result&gt;</p>
</td>
<td class="cellrowborder" valign="top" width="72.52%" headers="mcps1.1.3.1.2 "><p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p126364401194"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p126364401194"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p126364401194"></a>字符串，擦除/写入操作结果上报。</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p859521971016"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p859521971016"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p859521971016"></a>擦除成功上报："erase radioconfig file ok"</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p1781415820918"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p1781415820918"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p1781415820918"></a>擦除失败上报："erase radioconfig file fail"</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p12345184011107"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p12345184011107"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p12345184011107"></a>写入成功上报："update radioconfig file success, curr size:当前已写入字节数!"</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p230220583118"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p230220583118"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p230220583118"></a>写入失败上报："update radioconfig file fail"</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p7117349677"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p7117349677"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p7117349677"></a>重新加载成功上报："SUCCESSFULLY RELOAD"</p>
<p id="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p186122131813"><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p186122131813"></a><a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_p186122131813"></a>重新加载上报失败："FAILED RELOAD"</p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

**实现说明<a name="zh-cn_topic_0000002116984661_section163753741216"></a>**

-   该命令仅适用于radioconfig数据回写过程。已经整合入生成线的calibrate\_tools脚本中。请不要在其他场景下使用，否则会有“radioconfig.tlv”文件被损坏的风险。
-   确保在执行AT+NRCUPD=0成功后再使用写入命令更新radioconfig数据。

    如果在“OK”后打印信息“update radioconfig file success,curr size:xxx”，则表示数据写入成功，否则写入失败。

# 重置原因<a name="ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000002223512756"></a>

除外部重置的原因外，如果系统重新启动，将返回一条消息，指明重启原因。

单板启动后的复位原因会打印在AT\_UART口和AT\_USB口，若复位原因打印早于USB枚举结束，则复位原因不会显示到AT\_USB口。

可能的重启原因列表如下：
